title: "About"

I am an undergraduate student studying Computer Science and Mathematics at the University of Edinburgh. My interests lie primarily in theoretical computer science, with a particular focus on graph theory, approximation algorithms, complexity theory, and related areas of algorithms and discrete mathematics.

In summer 2026, I was a Summer Undergraduate Research Fellow at INSAIT, the Institute for Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence and Technology, in Sofia, Bulgaria. There, I conducted research in algorithms and theory.

## Education

## Experience

### INSAIT

**Summer Undergraduate Research Fellow**  
June-August 2026 - Sofia, Bulgaria

I undertook theoretical computer science research as part of INSAIT's Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship programme. My work concerned theoretical problems in algorithms and network routing.

Further details will be added when the associated work becomes publicly available.

- Approximation algorithms
